question: Identify exclusively virtual schools (Virtual = 'F') that rank among the top 3 in their county by total SAT score (sum of reading, math, and writing), and also have a difference greater than 50 between K-12 enrollment and Ages 5-17 enrollment. Return the school name, its total SAT score, county, and full street address.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.XCL_041 AS cds,
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    s.XCL_048 AS street_address,
    (t.XCL_037 + t.XCL_038 + t.XCL_039) AS total_sat
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
  JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
  WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
    AND (f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) > 50
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    b.cds,
    b.school_name,
    b.total_sat,
    b.county,
    b.street_address,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.county ORDER BY b.total_sat DESC) AS rnk
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
  r.school_name,
  r.total_sat,
  r.county,
  r.street_address
FROM ranked AS r
WHERE r.rnk <= 3

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.XCL_041 AS cds,
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    s.XCL_048 AS street_address,
    (t.XCL_037 + t.XCL_038 + t.XCL_039) AS total_sat
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
  JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
  WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
    AND (f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024) > 50
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    b.cds,
    b.school_name,
    b.total_sat,
    b.county,
    b.street_address,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.county ORDER BY b.total_sat DESC) AS rnk
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
  r.school_name,
  r.total_sat,
  r.county,
  r.street_address
FROM ranked AS r
WHERE r.rnk <= 3
